title: Polynomial algebra model for a prepared special chart
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures from R and R/(pi^2) to Cbar. Let d be prepared polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation], including epsilon, f_l, a_k, E_k, h_klj, g_kl and the explicit lifting quotient D. Set C0=Cbar/(pi Cbar) and D0=D/(pi D). Let c:Cbar to D0 be an R-algebra map sending epsilon(X_i) to the original generator x_i of D0, and cmod:C0 to D0 a ring map whose composite with Cbar to C0 is c. For any chart k put a0 equal to the image of epsilon(reduced(a_k)) in C0, and t=c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))). Then the polynomial algebra C0[1/a0][z_j : j in E_k] is isomorphic as a C0-algebra to D0[1/t], with D0 viewed as a C0-algebra through cmod. No prime, annihilator, or Noetherian assumption is made.

proof.text: Write P=R[x], Q=P[z], u_l=f_l-pi z_l and p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}. Modulo pi and after inverting a_k, the cleared relation expresses every f_l in the ideal of the f_j with j in E_k. The normalized p_{kl} for l in E_k are zero. Eliminate z_l for l outside E_k using p_{kl}=0.

proof.text: For another chart k prime and j in E_k, set b_j=a_{k prime}h_{klj}-sum_{j prime in E_{k prime}}h_{k prime,l,j prime}h_{k,j prime,j}. Comparing the expressions for a_k a_{k prime} f_l in the reduced conormal module gives sum b_j f_j=0. The specified basis on chart k makes every b_j zero in Cbar localized at a_k. Equality in localization clears a power of a_k, placing that multiple in I+pi^2P. In D/pi D all f_l are already zero. The expansion a_k p_{k prime,l}-a_{k prime}p_{kl}+sum h_{k prime,l,j prime}p_{k,j prime}=sum b_j z_j modulo pi therefore makes every extra p relation redundant.

proof.text: The quotient after inverting a_k is consequently (Cbar/pi Cbar)_{a_k}[z_j : j in E_k]. The inverse sends each complementary z_l to a_k inverse times sum h_{klj}z_j. The two substitutions fix the original x_i and the remaining z_j, and their composites fix each eliminated z_l by its relation. Surjectivity and kernel of epsilon identify the coefficient quotient; the generator identity hc and the quotient identity hcmod identify its map with cmod. ULift is transported by its algebra equivalence. This proves a C0-algebra isomorphism, before making any smoothness deduction.

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_special_chart_polynomial (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom)
    (k : Fin d.r) :
    let C₀ := Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)
    letI := cmod.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (MvPolynomial (d.E k)
      (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))))) ≃ₐ[C₀]
      Localization.Away (c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k)))))
